goal: Play a full round: put out fires, rescue everyone, refill water
summary: The playtester spent all 10 steps trying to equip gear from the locker-room racks and the truck lockers. Every interact returned 'held, not triggered' even in range, so it never got a tool and never fought a fire, rescued anyone, or refilled water. Meanwhile the fire simulation kept running in the background (fires spread, a structure was lost, 5 NPCs toasted), and the probe logged no errors.

bugs.title: Gear rack and truck locker prompts never trigger; players cannot get any tool
bugs.evidence: Steps 1, 2 and 4: 'Grab Axe Gear Rack' (GearRack1) returned 'held, not triggered' at 7.8 studs and again at about 3 studs. Step 5: GearRack2 'Grab Extinguisher' failed. Steps 8, 9 and 10: truck Locker_R2 'Grab Extinguisher' and Locker_R1 'Grab Axe' (2.0 studs, range 9) failed. The Carrying attribute stayed empty throughout, so the round could not be played. Both the path form and the key E hold 0.5 were tried.

bugs.title: Nozzle role starts with no hose or tool
bugs.evidence: The player's role is 'nozzle (fight fires)', yet the backpack is empty from step 1 and no hose or nozzle is given at spawn. Combined with the failing prompts, there is no way to fight fires.

bugs.title: HUD fire count disagrees with world state and mission ID
bugs.evidence: Playtesters reported the HUD showing 'FIRES LEFT 7' and 'FIRES LEFT 4' while world.instance.fires was 0, and MissionId 'City' versus instance missionId 'house_fire'. These are reports from the playtesters, not visible in the trace excerpt shown to me, so they are lower confidence.

bugs.title: Fire and structure tick budget overruns
bugs.evidence: Probe counters show fire_tick_over_budget=8 and structure_tick_over_budget=1 with city_parts=25105. The server fire and structure ticks are exceeding their time budget, which could cause lag. No errors were logged.
